art_direction.topic: Deep-sea mining, critical-mineral geopolitics, and the race to control the ocean floor
art_direction.source_treatment: Full-screen official evidence, restrained map animation, real expedition imagery, and explicitly labelled source-derived graphics
visual_motifs: Abyssal darkness interrupted by machine lights
Bathymetric maps and contract blocks replacing conventional borders
Polymetallic nodules and rare-earth mud presented as strategic objects rather than treasure
Surface command rooms contrasted with unknown deep-sea ecosystems
avoid: Continuous document/table sequences without contextual footage
Claims that all deep-sea mineral deposits or mining methods are environmentally equivalent

end_card.title: WHAT WE CAN EXTRACT
end_card.subtitle: AND WHAT WE AGREE NOT TO DESTROY
